web.title: deno compile is not compatible with pnpm store #30509
web.description: Complex scenarios with symlinks in node_modules (such as those produced by pnpm) would work fine with deno run but break with deno compile, as the latter would be unable to resolve some modules. My guess is that deno compile is unable to include in its VFS multiple symlinks with the same target. To be confirmed.

web.title: deno compile | Deno Docs
web.description: By default, deno compile embeds the entire resolved node_modules tree in the executable. For projects with many npm dependencies this can make binaries large and slow to start.

web.title: Node-Modules & Hoisting Settings - pnpm
web.description: When enabled, node_modules contains only symlinks to a central virtual store, rather than to node_modules/.pnpm. By default, this central store is located at <store-path>/links (use pnpm store path to find <store-path>).
